instruction: I want to adjust VLC's audio normalization settings to prevent sudden volume spikes. Please enable volume normalization in VLC Media Player preferences.

metadata.explanation: This task requires enabling audio normalization in VLC. This is infeasible because the current config launches VLC with --no-audio flag, making audio settings irrelevant. Even without this flag, verifying audio normalization would require audio playback testing and volume level analysis, which cannot be reliably evaluated in the OSWorld environment.

llm_judge_reasons: The 'infeasible' evaluator is semantically correct for this task
Config launches VLC with --no-audio flag, making audio normalization settings irrelevant regardless of UI state

Even without the --no-audio flag, verifying audio normalization requires runtime audio analysis (volume spike detection, normalization effect verification) which is beyond OSWorld's evaluation capabilities
Checking only UI state (checkbox enabled) would not verify actual functionality - true verification requires audio playback and real-time volume level analysis
The task is fundamentally unverifiable in the OSWorld environment, not just difficult
